2607.21517.title: Improved lower bounds for the Shannon capacity of odd cycles
2607.21517.paper_summary: The Shannon capacity $Θ(G)$ of a graph $G$ quantifies the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted with zero error over a noisy channel. It is lower bounded by $α(G^d)^{1/d}$ for any $d$, where $α(G^d)$ is the independence number of the $d$-th strong power of $G$. We construct independent sets of size $134753$ in $C_7^{10}$, $21909$ in $C_{11}^{6}$, and $62530$ in $C_{13}^{6}$, improving the best known lower bounds for the Shannon capacity of these graphs to $Θ(C_7)\geq 134753^{1/10}>3.258020$, $Θ(C_{11})\geq 21909^{1/6}>5.289773$, and $Θ(C_{13})\geq 62530^{1/6}>6.300109$. We also improve the best known lower bounds on the independence numbers of several individual strong powers of odd cycles that do not improve the Shannon capacity lower bound. The constructions were discovered through iterative interactions with a Large Language Model (LLM), illustrating the potential of LLMs for finding explicit combinatorial constructions.
2607.21517.paper_summary_zh: 香農容量 $Θ(G)$ 是圖 $G$ 的一個量度，量化了在有噪聲的通道上以零錯誤傳輸信息的最大速率。對於任何 $d$，它的下界為 $α(G^d)^{1/d}$，其中 $α(G^d)$ 是 $G$ 的第 $d$ 次強冪的獨立數。我們在 $C_7^{10}$ 中構造了大小為 $134753$ 的獨立集，在 $C_{11}^{6}$ 中構造了 $21909$，以及在 $C_{13}^{6}$ 中構造了 $62530$，將這些圖的香農容量的最佳已知下界改善為 $Θ(C_7)\geq 134753^{1/10}>3.258020$，$Θ(C_{11})\geq 21909^{1/6}>5.289773$，以及 $Θ(C_{13})\geq 62530^{1/6}>6.300109$。我們還改善了幾個單獨奇數循環的強冪的獨立數的最佳已知下界，這些下界並未改善香農容量的下界。這些構造是通過與大型語言模型 (LLM) 的迭代互動發現的，展示了 LLM 在尋找明確組合構造方面的潛力。
